name: DEXTROMETHORPHAN 300 MG SYRUP 120 ML
description: Dextromethorphan syrup (300 mg/120 ml) is an antitussive that acts on the cough center in the brain, reducing the cough reflex. It is useful for relieving dry, irritating, or nervous coughs, but not coughs with phlegm. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
